blocks.html: Where required by the New York City Fire Code or this code, mechanical ventilation, treatment systems, temperature control, alarm, detection or other electrically operated systems shall be provided with emergency or standby power in accordance with Section 2702 of this code. For storage and use areas for highly toxic or toxic materials, see the New York City Fire Code.
